meta.title: Kinvia — Comprehensive Tech Partner: Cloud, Software & IoT
meta.description: Profitability & Optimization. Integration & Proximity. Custom software engineering, Cloud Native architecture, In-House IT, and autonomous Smart Spaces focused on your ROI.

hero.subtitle: Comprehensive Tech Partner: Software Engineering, Cloud Architecture & IT Outsourcing.
hero.lead: We are not distant vendors—we sit on your side of the table as your own engineering department. Technology that multiplies your performance, not your costs.

axes.eyebrow: 01 · From Cloud to the Physical World
axes.title: Two business units driven by the same engineering rigor
axes.subtitle: We translate 20+ years of building mission-critical systems into measurable business impact, with 100% vendor-agnostic honesty.

cloud.title: Cloud & Software
cloud.tagline: High-performance engineering boutique. The brain of a tech giant with the agility and proximity of a local partner.
cloud.description: From running your entire IT operations (In-House IT) with enterprise-grade reliability tailored to a predictable monthly fee, to building custom software, Cloud Native platforms, and sovereign AI without traditional consultancy bloat.
outcomes: Enterprise-grade peace of mind, immutable backups, and proactive cybersecurity for mid-market companies.
Scalable Linux and container architectures with zero vendor lock-in.
Measurable cloud and licensing cost reductions through rigorous FinOps audits.

iot.title: IoT & Smart Spaces
iot.tagline: Invisible technology, real independence, total peace of mind.
iot.description: We transform luxury residences, real estate developments, and agricultural operations (AgTech) through cognitive automation and 100% local Edge Computing on open hardware. Your property learns routines, anticipates weather, and stays 100% operational even if internet connectivity drops.
outcomes: 100% local processing (offline-first) with zero mandatory third-party clouds or closed proprietary buses.
Privacy by design using non-invasive mmWave radar presence sensing—never intrusive indoor cameras.
Preventive remote maintenance via autonomous Watchdog telemetry and secure OTA updates.

services.title: Engineering tailored to your problem, not our catalog
services.subtitle: Every technical decision is backed by its concrete economic and operational return on your bottom line.

items.title: In-House IT (External Systems Department)
items.summary: Your engineering team off your payroll but inside your business: Linux servers, networks, immutable backups, preventive security, and local office automation with direct support.

items.title: Custom Software Development
items.summary: Modern web applications, SaaS platforms, low-latency APIs, business process automation (BPM), and ERP/CRM integrations built with clean, lock-in-free code.

items.title: Applied AI & Cloud Architecture
items.summary: Practical AI agents, corporate RAG, and document workflows with strict data sovereignty, paired with resilient Linux and container infrastructures.

items.title: Resource Optimization & Tech ROI (FinOps)
items.summary: Cloud bill and software license audits to eliminate waste, right-size workloads, optimize databases, and migrate to high-ROI Open Source alternatives.

items.title: IoT, Cognitive Home Automation & AgTech
items.summary: Luxury homes, residential developments, and smart farms with predictive energy and irrigation management on local Edge hubs, long-range telemetry, and offline resilience.

model.title: Zero black boxes. Zero billing surprises.
model.subtitle: Three transparent engagement models designed to protect your budget and give you full ownership from day one.

items.title: Fixed Monthly Retainer + Hour Bank
items.description: Complete budget predictability. We keep your infrastructure monitored, patched, and secure proactively, while your dedicated hour bank covers reactive support, evolutionary improvements, and ongoing automation.
highlights: Predictable fixed monthly fee with zero surprise invoices
Continuous preventive monitoring to stop outages before they happen
Flexible hour bank for support, consulting, and continuous improvements

items.title: Collaborative 3-Phase Projects
items.description: We never push a single rigid solution. We work side-by-side with you to choose the architecture that best fits your budget and growth stage.
highlights: Phase 1 · Joint Discovery to map real bottlenecks and budget constraints
Phase 2 · 2–3 tiered technical options detailing trade-offs, OpEx, and timelines
Phase 3 · Hand-in-hand production rollout with early deliveries and team enablement

items.title: Open CapEx Installation + Watchdog/OTA Subscription
items.description: You truly own your open hardware from day one without proprietary lock-in, backed by proactive remote maintenance.
highlights: Initial CapEx deployment on open hardware and a local Linux Edge Hub
Remote Watchdog self-healing diagnostics and early sensor/network alerting
Encrypted remote backups and secure OTA updates without disruptive on-site visits

privacy.title: Privacy Policy (Brief Notice)
privacy.intro: At Kinvia we apply Privacy by Design and by Default. We only collect the minimum information required to answer your enquiry.
privacy.controllerText: Kinvia (Enrique) · Primary location: Orihuela Costa, Alicante, Spain · Email: info@kinvia.es · Phone: +34 644 21 93 52.
privacy.purposeText: To respond to technical enquiries, commercial requests, or support questions submitted via the contact form, direct email, or phone.
privacy.dataText: We only collect the fields submitted in the contact form: name, email address, and your message. We do not use advertising cookies or Google Analytics on this MVP site. Your personal data is never sold, shared with third parties for marketing, or sent to public AI models.
privacy.rightsText: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, or objection regarding your personal data at any time by emailing info@kinvia.es.
